paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: figures/ablation_title.pdf

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score percentages of different MADLLM configurations across various datasets. The horizontal axis lists the categories, which are datasets labeled as SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score in percentage, ranging from 60% to 100% with regular tick intervals marked every 10 percentage points, indicating a linear scale. For each dataset, four bars are grouped together, each representing a different MADLLM configuration: "MADLLM" in green, "MADLLM w/o prompt pool" in blue, "MADLLM w/o feature embedding" in purple, and "MADLLM w/o skip embedding" in orange. In the SMD dataset, the bars range approximately from 90% to 93%, with the green bar being the tallest and the purple bar being the shortest. For the PSM dataset, the green, orange, and purple bars each exceed approximately 90%, while the blue bar is significantly shorter, around 75% and the green bar is the tallest, with approximately 96%. The SWaT dataset displays green and purple bars with heights near or exceeding 90% with green being the tallest and blue and orange reaches around 84 and 85, respectively. In SMAP, the green bar reaches approximately 94%, with the other bars significantly lower, with orange being the shortest, with approximately 66%. The MSL dataset shows the green, purple, and orange bars around 85%, while the blue bar is the shortest, approximately 70%. Finally, for WADI, the purple bar is approximately 63%, with purple being the shortest, the blue bar around 65% and the green bar being the tallest with around 74%. The bars are not ordered in any particular sequence, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation. A legend is placed at the bottom of the plot.
